name: @mcp-graph-workflow/cli
description: Internal workspace for @mcp-graph-workflow/mcp-graph — bundled CLI surface (REPL, hooks, lifecycle). Not published to npm; consumed by the parent package via local bundle copy. Use @mcp-graph-workflow/mcp-graph instead.
author: Diego Lima Nogueira de Paula

scripts.build: npm run clean && esbuild src/cli.tsx --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" --tree-shaking=true --minify --define:DEV=false --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --drop:debugger --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=react --external:react-devtools-core --external:fsevents --external:better-sqlite3 --external:@modelcontextprotocol/sdk
